## What I bring to the table

- Turning data into decisions — transforming raw data into organized, meaningful insights and polished reporting.
- Building practical AI and data solutions — applying Python, SQL, analytics, and AI/LLM technologies to real-world problems.
- Making complex work understandable — creating dashboards, visualizations, and presentations that communicate technical results clearly to stakeholders.
